chapter: First Blue Note recording with Jackie McLean
title: Planning a part two and closing
summary: Rowe proposes a second session and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s a terrific story. I’m going to make a proposal here. We’ve been talking for an hour and I wonder if I could engage you for a part 2 in the near future?

All right. Because there’s lots of things I haven’t got to and some things I want to follow up. I mean just like you just said Alfred “started the stopwatch.” Well I want to know about that. So we’ll return to some of those things. So I’ll pause our recording and we’ll say goodbye for today and we’ll meet down the road.
